messages:
sophie: Quick thread to lock down contract for streaming resume and finish semantics. Need a minimal API that satisfies customers + operational constraints. Summary first: prefer single, small surface that covers SSE+WS, explicit resume modes, and structured finish events.

lucas: Customer side: mobile/web SDKs need predictable markers to show partial results, and a single semantic for "final" so UI can stop spinners. Also need a deterministic hook when a function call will be emitted vs. when it's still streaming partial args.

tanya: Product asks: 1) clearly enumerate MUST/SHOULD/CAN for launch; 2) behavior when resume token expired; 3) how function calls are surfaced mid-stream vs at final.

kevin: Runtime constraints: two main knobs: how much state we materialize for resume, and what we accept as a resume key. Implementation-friendly approach: resume token encodes model, model-version, and a seq cursor referencing a persisted KV snapshot id. Tokens short-lived for hosted, longer for Dedicated. If token invalid => server emits a `finish` with reason `resume_unavailable` and includes last-acknowledged seq in the delta stream.

lucas: UX implication: client should treat `resume_unavailable` as recoverable: show "partial result, reconnect to continue" CTA. If `resume_unavailable` occurs, we need stable last-seq to re-run a short recontextualization call (non-streaming) for fidelity.

sophie: Proposed API deltas (backward-compatible): every stream chunk is a JSON delta event. Minimal schema v1: {"type":"delta","seq":"<int>","kind":"content|function|finish|meta","payload":{...}}. For finish: payload.finish_reason in enum.

kevin: Enumerated finish_reason v1: completed, cancelled_by_client, error, resume_unavailable, function_call_deferred, truncated_by_policy. Note: `function_call_deferred` means server detected a call but will emit a separate function event later (or at finish).

tanya: For function calls during streaming we have two modes: inline-args (emit partial arg deltas until completed then finish with a `function` kind), or deferred (emit `meta` kind indicating a pending function call id and then a final `function` event). Which to default to? Customers prefer partial args to show progress but that complicates resume.

kevin: Default: deferred for hosted (simpler to resume), inline-args available as a feature flag for Dedicated/Private. Inline-args require KV checkpoints at arg boundaries. Document in SDK: when receiving `kind:function` with partial arg deltas, SDK must buffer and reassemble. Provide sample delta sequence in the thread.

sophie: Example delta stream (SSE-style payload lines in a single message):

```
event: delta
data: {"type":"delta","seq":101,"kind":"content","payload":{"text":"Hi"}}

event: delta
data: {"type":"delta","seq":102,"kind":"content","payload":{"text":", how can I"}}

event: delta
data: {"type":"delta","seq":103,"kind":"function","payload":{"status":"partial","fn":"call_api","args_chunk":"{\"id\":\"42\"}"}}

event: delta
data: {"type":"delta","seq":104,"kind":"finish","payload":{"finish_reason":"function_call_deferred"}}
```

lucas: SDK guidelines: on reconnect with a resume token, server should replay from seq+1. Client-side should dedupe by seq ids. If server can't resume, it sends a `finish` with `resume_unavailable` and includes `last_seq`.

kevin: Telemetry to gate rollout: resume_attempts, resume_success_rate, percent_streams_using_function_partial, median-first-byte-time, tail-latency-95. Ops threshold for canary: resume_success_rate >= 99.5 and no >5% increase in 95p latency.

tanya: Launch MUSTs: SDK parsing for seq and kind, server emits finish_reason enum, hosted supports soft-resume (server gives last_seq but no KV restore), Dedicated supports full-resume. SHOULDs: inline-args support for Dedicated. CANs: client-side multiplexing priorities (WS multiplex not required at launch).

sophie: Rollout plan: feature-flag gated in hosted (soft-resume + deferred-functions only). Dedicated customers can request full-resume + inline-args via support ticket. Canary window 7 days in a single region, monitor metrics above.

ops-bot: Created INF-7901: "streaming-resume-finish-contract" assigned to kevin,tanya,lucas.

sophie: Action items: kevin write runtime resume design doc; lucas draft SDK readme + example; tanya assemble MUST/SHOULD/CAN and acceptance tests. Back here with docs by Thursday.
